card.name: Middle initial in William names
card.fires_on: The period after a middle initial, or the next name part, in a person's name beginning with William or Willard (William S. Burroughs, William J. Kaufmann).

modes.label: Period after initial
modes.description: The full stop after a single middle initial following William or Willard, just before the surname.

modes.label: Surname slot after William
modes.description: The surname or middle name right after William or its initial, as in Kaufmann or Wells Brown.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a name like William S. Burroughs, just before the surname.
